text.tspan: OT-2 deck map: will run sdl_solubility_ot2.py
P300 GEN2 single (left) · P20 GEN2 single (right) · heater-shaker in slot 10 · up to 3 identical plates
1 Fill all plates in one pass: each solvent once (P20 below 20 µL, P300 above 20 µL)
2 Pause: seal all plates by hand
3 Move each plate onto the heater-shaker (prompted) → shake → read on UV-Vis
